title: A film from a written look
summary: Make a 24-second film from one short written look, nothing literal, in a single autonomous turn.
originNote: Original task written for this Recipe after Burooj asked that film Recipes taste art style and graphic invention. The written look is the only creative input.

setup.instructions: Read fixtures/brief.md. Kitchen supplies the same pinned film toolchain (Node 22, Python, Chromium, FFmpeg and fonts) and compute profile to every compared model. Before Ready, this Recipe's checks must be smoked in that toolchain; this draft is not cookable.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.md. Make the film in the written look and deliver the movie, live player, source, contact sheet and evidence it specifies. Make every creative decision yourself and iterate from rendered evidence.

checks.description: Check delivery files, unchanged player, PNG signature, H.264/AAC, 1080 by 1350, 24fps, 576 frames, 24 seconds, complete decode, true peak at or below -0.1 dBTP and evidence shape.
What did the model think the phrase means, and is the reading its own? Is anything literal left? Does it feel like a memory? Is the look held from the first frame to the last?

variation: One-shot sibling of three-styleframes-then-film: same written look, note and film, without the styleframes or the selection.
